rider.prompt: Use case: compositing. Asset type: transparent game character sprite for a small glass chamber in a warm toy-like 3D workshop. Input image 1: exact orange wizard identity. Input image 2: exact brown bear identity. Create ONE cohesive duo: the small orange wizard sits astride the bear's back, legs visibly bent hanging naturally on both sides, holding his gold-orb staff. Bear stands on four paws facing front-left in same three-quarter view as reference. Preserve orange pointed hat with brown band and gold buckle, ivory beard, orange cloak; preserve brown faceted bear, yellow eyes and cyan forehead diamond. Wizard should be smaller than bear, clearly riding rather than standing or floating. Match references' polished low-poly 3D toy style, warm upper-right key light and cyan left rim light. Entire bear, wizard, hat and staff visible; centered, compact silhouette occupying 85% canvas, modest transparent margins. Actual transparent background, no ground plane, no scenery, no glass, no pedestal, no text, no extra characters.

Input 1 is the ACTUAL VORTEX level-4 upgraded mage from the game and is the identity reference; input 2 is the existing portfolio mage and is ONLY a lighting/render-quality reference. No bear, no scenery, no ground plane, no text, no level labels.
